description: SLA - Attribution aux particuliers de la prime vélo par commune depuis 2019 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Saint-Louis Agglomération. Saint-Louis Agglomération has set up aid for the purchase of a bicycle for residents of Saint-Louis Agglomération, under the following conditions: • EUR 200 maximum for the purchase of an electric or cargo bike • EUR 100 maximum for the purchase of a city bike, mountain bike or folding bike The premium is capped at ... Coverage: Saint-Louis Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "SLA – Attribution to individuals of the bicycle premium per municipality since 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Saint-Louis Agglomération. Its keywords include environnement, mobilite, velo, environnement-climat-energies. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
